description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - 3 KING bedrooms, all with en-suite baths and TVs - Awesome kids room with queen bed, 4 bunks- sleeps up to 6! Sitting area and large TV with gaming area! - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - Gas grill and wonderful outdoor porches! - Wifi streaming TVs - Fully stocked kitchen - Access to the community pool (seasonally heated) - Short 7 minute walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. Located in Old Seagrove's community, The Grove by the Sea, "Heavenly Sunshine" is a renovated and custom decorated 4 bedroom, 4 bath beach home. Just a short 7 minute walk to the beach, this cottage is one of the most family friendly homes that sleeps 10 comfortably. Screened porches, balconies, and back decks make this beautiful home as much fun outside as it is in. Upon entering the screened porch, you'll enjoy a porch swing and outdoor seating perfect for that morning cup of coffee or afternoon book. The main living space offers an oversized family room and open concept to eat-in kitchen and dining space (seats 8) along with an updated kitchen with bar seating for 5 more people. 'Heavenly Sunshine' is located steps to the 2 shared community pools. Beach access is located a short 7 minute walk down the street. Seagrove shops and restaurants are also a short walk away and downtown Seaside is a short bike ride away! Enjoy the "heavenly sunshine" when you stay at this beautiful Seagrove beach home!
